title: Rick And Morty keyless
script:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local backpack=player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

local GREEN=Color3.fromRGB(45,255,90)
local LIGHT_GREEN=Color3.fromRGB(150,255,170)
local BODY=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,145)
local DARK=Color3.fromRGB(55,57,55)

local GUN_SCALE=.45

-- Portal entry cooldown
local PORTAL_COOLDOWN=1
local portalCooldown=false

local portals={Portal1=nil,Portal2=nil}
local connections={Portal1=nil,Portal2=nil}
local selectedPortal="Portal1"
local gunConnection=nil
local gunEquipped=false

local function removePortal(name)
	if connections[name] then
		connections[name]:Disconnect()
		connections[name]=nil
	end

	if portals[name] then
		portals[name]:Destroy()
		portals[name]=nil
	end
end

local function createPortal(name,pos)
	local character=player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end

	local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X,pos.Y)

	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}

	local hit=workspace:Raycast(
		ray.Origin,
		ray.Direction*1000,
		params
	)

	if not hit then return end

	removePortal(name)

	local position=hit.Position
	local normal=hit.Normal
	local up=Vector3.yAxis

	if math.abs(normal:Dot(up))>.95 then
		up=Vector3.xAxis
	end

	local portalCFrame=CFrame.lookAt(
		position+normal*.05,
		position+normal,
		up
	)

	local model=Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name=name
	model.Parent=workspace
	portals[name]=model

	local portal=Instance.new("Part")
	portal.Name="Portal"
	portal.Size=Vector3.new(7,10,.4)
	portal.CFrame=portalCFrame
	portal.Color=GREEN
	portal.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
	portal.Transparency=.25
	portal.Anchored=true
	portal.CanCollide=false
	portal.CanTouch=true
	portal.CanQuery=false
	portal.Parent=model

	local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Scale=Vector3.new(.55,1,.07)
	mesh.Parent=portal

	local inner=Instance.new("Part")
	inner.Name="PortalCore"
	inner.Size=Vector3.new(6.2,9.2,.15)
	inner.CFrame=portalCFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,-.12)
	inner.Color=LIGHT_GREEN
	inner.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
	inner.Transparency=.35
	inner.Anchored=true
	inner.CanCollide=false
	inner.CanTouch=false
	inner.CanQuery=false
	inner.Parent=model

	local innerMesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	innerMesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	innerMesh.Scale=Vector3.new(.55,1,.05)
	innerMesh.Parent=inner

	local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color=GREEN
	light.Brightness=8
	light.Range=18
	light.Parent=portal

	local attachment=Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent=portal

	local particles=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Color=ColorSequence.new(GREEN)
	particles.LightEmission=1
	particles.LightInfluence=0
	particles.Rate=120
	particles.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.4,1)
	particles.Speed=NumberRange.new(1,4)
	particles.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180)
	particles.Size=NumberSequence.new{
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,.08),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)
	}
	particles.Parent=attachment

	for i=1,4 do
		local ring=Instance.new("Part")
		ring.Name="EnergyRing"
		ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ring.Size=Vector3.new(.08,6+i*.55,6+i*.55)

		ring.CFrame=
			portalCFrame*
			CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad(90),
				0,
				math.rad(i*45)
			)

		ring.Color=GREEN
		ring.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
		ring.Transparency=.3
		ring.Anchored=true
		ring.CanCollide=false
		ring.CanTouch=false
		ring.CanQuery=false
		ring.Parent=model
	end

	local start=os.clock()

	connections[name]=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not model.Parent then return end

		local elapsed=os.clock()-start
		local pulse=1+math.sin(elapsed*5)*.06

		portal.Size=Vector3.new(7,10,.4)*pulse

		local index=0

		for _,object in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if object.Name=="EnergyRing" then
				index+=1

				object.CFrame=
					portal.CFrame*
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(90),
						elapsed*(index*.8),
						math.rad(index*45)
					)
			end
		end
	end)

	portal.Touched:Connect(function(hitPart)

		-- 1 second global portal cooldown
		if portalCooldown then return end

		if not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(character) then return end

		local destination=
			name=="Portal1"
			and "Portal2"
			or "Portal1"

		local destinationModel=portals[destination]
		if not destinationModel then return end

		local destinationPortal=
			destinationModel:FindFirstChild("Portal")

		if not destinationPortal then return end

		local root=
			character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not root then return end

		portalCooldown=true

		-- Small delay before teleport
		task.wait(.15)

		-- Teleport through the destination portal
		root.CFrame=
			destinationPortal.CFrame*
			CFrame.new(0,0,-4)

		-- Keep the player upright
		local position=root.Position

		root.CFrame=CFrame.new(position)*CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			math.rad(root.Orientation.Y),
			0
		)

		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero

		-- 1 second cooldown
		task.wait(PORTAL_COOLDOWN)

		portalCooldown=false
	end)

	-- Infinite portal lifetime
end

local function makePart(parent,name,size,color,material,cframe)
	local part=Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name=name
	part.Size=size
	part.Color=color
	part.Material=material
	part.CFrame=cframe
	part.CanCollide=false
	part.CanTouch=false
	part.CanQuery=false
	part.Massless=true
	part.CastShadow=false
	part.Parent=parent

	return part
end

local function weldPart(part,handle)
	local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint")

	weld.Part0=handle
	weld.Part1=part
	weld.Parent=part
end

local function createPortalGun()

	local tool=Instance.new("Tool")

	tool.Name="Portal Gun"
	tool.RequiresHandle=true
	tool.CanBeDropped=false
	tool.ToolTip="Tap/click a surface to place a portal"

	local handle=Instance.new("Part")

	handle.Name="Handle"
	handle.Size=Vector3.new(.72,2.35,.72)
	handle.Color=DARK
	handle.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	handle.CanCollide=false
	handle.CanTouch=false
	handle.CanQuery=false
	handle.Massless=true
	handle.CastShadow=false
	handle.Parent=tool

	-- Grip: 0, 90, 0
	tool.Grip=
		CFrame.new(0,0,0)*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			math.rad(90),
			0
		)

	local body=makePart(
		tool,
		"MainBody",
		Vector3.new(3.6,.75,2.1),
		BODY,
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(-1.55,1.4,0)
	)
	weldPart(body,handle)

	local bottom=makePart(
		tool,
		"BottomBody",
		Vector3.new(3.25,.18,1.8),
		Color3.fromRGB(90,92,90),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(-1.55,.97,0)
	)
	weldPart(bottom,handle)

	local front=makePart(
		tool,
		"FrontPanel",
		Vector3.new(.15,.62,1.75),
		Color3.fromRGB(65,67,65),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(-3.37,1.4,0)
	)
	weldPart(front,handle)

	for i=-1,1 do

		local emitter=Instance.new("Part")

		emitter.Name="GreenEmitter"
		emitter.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		emitter.Size=Vector3.new(.16,.43,.43)
		emitter.Color=GREEN
		emitter.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
		emitter.CanCollide=false
		emitter.CanTouch=false
		emitter.CanQuery=false
		emitter.Massless=true

		emitter.CFrame=
			handle.CFrame*
			CFrame.new(-3.46,1.4,i*.55)*
			CFrame.Angles(
				0,
				math.rad(90),
				0
			)

		emitter.Parent=tool
		weldPart(emitter,handle)

		local light=Instance.new("PointLight")

		light.Color=GREEN
		light.Brightness=1.5
		light.Range=4
		light.Parent=emitter
	end

	local top=makePart(
		tool,
		"TopPlate",
		Vector3.new(2.9,.12,1.75),
		Color3.fromRGB(170,170,165),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(-1.4,1.83,0)
	)
	weldPart(top,handle)

	local red=makePart(
		tool,
		"RedPanel",
		Vector3.new(.9,.08,.62),
		Color3.fromRGB(210,45,45),
		Enum.Material.Neon,
		handle.CFrame*CFrame.new(-.65,1.93,0)
	)
	weldPart(red,handle)

	local chamber=Instance.new("Part")

	chamber.Name="EnergyGlass"
	chamber.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	chamber.Size=Vector3.new(1.75,1.35,1.35)
	chamber.Color=Color3.fromRGB(170,255,190)
	chamber.Material=Enum.Material.Glass
	chamber.Transparency=.48
	chamber.Reflectance=.08
	chamber.CanCollide=false
	chamber.CanTouch=false
	chamber.CanQuery=false
	chamber.Massless=true

	chamber.CFrame=
		handle.CFrame*
		CFrame.new(-2.2,2.95,0)*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			0,
			math.rad(90)
		)

	chamber.Parent=tool
	weldPart(chamber,handle)

	local chamberTop=Instance.new("Part")

	chamberTop.Name="GlassTop"
	chamberTop.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	chamberTop.Size=Vector3.new(.22,1.35,1.35)
	chamberTop.Color=Color3.fromRGB(180,180,175)
	chamberTop.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	chamberTop.CanCollide=false
	chamberTop.CanTouch=false
	chamberTop.CanQuery=false
	chamberTop.Massless=true

	chamberTop.CFrame=
		handle.CFrame*
		CFrame.new(-2.2,3.82,0)*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			0,
			math.rad(90)
		)

	chamberTop.Parent=tool
	weldPart(chamberTop,handle)

	local core=Instance.new("Part")

	core.Name="PortalCore"
	core.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
	core.Size=Vector3.new(.65,.85,.65)
	core.Color=GREEN
	core.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
	core.Transparency=.08
	core.CanCollide=false
	core.CanTouch=false
	core.CanQuery=false
	core.Massless=true

	core.CFrame=
		handle.CFrame*
		CFrame.new(-2.2,2.97,0)

	core.Parent=tool
	weldPart(core,handle)

	local coreLight=Instance.new("PointLight")

	coreLight.Color=GREEN
	coreLight.Brightness=3
	coreLight.Range=7
	coreLight.Parent=core

	local coreAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment")
	coreAttachment.Parent=core

	local coreParticles=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")

	coreParticles.Color=ColorSequence.new(GREEN)
	coreParticles.LightEmission=1
	coreParticles.LightInfluence=0
	coreParticles.Rate=18
	coreParticles.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.3,.7)
	coreParticles.Speed=NumberRange.new(.2,.8)
	coreParticles.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180)
	coreParticles.Size=NumberSequence.new{
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.09),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)
	}
	coreParticles.Parent=coreAttachment

	local gripBottom=makePart(
		tool,
		"GripBottom",
		Vector3.new(.82,.65,.82),
		Color3.fromRGB(48,50,48),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		handle.CFrame*
		CFrame.new(.35,-1,0)*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			0,
			math.rad(-18)
		)
	)
	weldPart(gripBottom,handle)

	local gripTop=makePart(
		tool,
		"GripTop",
		Vector3.new(.85,.75,.85),
		DARK,
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		handle.CFrame*
		CFrame.new(-.4,.8,0)*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			0,
			math.rad(-18)
		)
	)
	weldPart(gripTop,handle)

	local gripInsert=makePart(
		tool,
		"GripInsert",
		Vector3.new(.5,1.7,.75),
		Color3.fromRGB(35,37,35),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		handle.CFrame*
		CFrame.new(.02,0,-.38)*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			0,
			math.rad(-18)
		)
	)
	weldPart(gripInsert,handle)

	local gripLight=makePart(
		tool,
		"GripLight",
		Vector3.new(.08,1.1,.2),
		GREEN,
		Enum.Material.Neon,
		handle.CFrame*
		CFrame.new(-.35,.1,-.43)*
		CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			0,
			math.rad(-18)
		)
	)
	weldPart(gripLight,handle)

	-- Scale the complete gun to 45%
	local parts={}

	for _,obj in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(parts,obj)
		end
	end

	for _,part in ipairs(parts) do

		if part~=handle then

			local relative=
				handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)

			local p=
				relative.Position*GUN_SCALE

			part.Size=
				part.Size*GUN_SCALE

			part.CFrame=
				handle.CFrame*
				CFrame.new(p)*
				CFrame.fromMatrix(
					Vector3.zero,
					relative.XVector,
					relative.YVector,
					relative.ZVector
				)
		end
	end

	handle.Size=
		handle.Size*GUN_SCALE

	tool.Equipped:Connect(function()

		gunEquipped=true

		if gunConnection then
			gunConnection:Disconnect()
		end

		gunConnection=
			RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

				if not core.Parent then return end

				local pulse=
					1+math.sin(os.clock()*5)*.12

				core.Size=
					Vector3.new(.65,.85,.65)*
					GUN_SCALE*
					pulse

				coreLight.Brightness=
					3+math.sin(os.clock()*5)
			end)
	end)

	tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()

		gunEquipped=false

		if gunConnection then
			gunConnection:Disconnect()
			gunConnection=nil
		end
	end)

	tool.Parent=backpack
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)

	if processed or not gunEquipped then return end

	local valid=
		input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch

	if not valid then return end

	local position=
		Vector2.new(
			input.Position.X,
			input.Position.Y
		)

	createPortal(
		selectedPortal,
		position
	)

	selectedPortal=
		selectedPortal=="Portal1"
		and "Portal2"
		or "Portal1"
end)

local function setup()

	local old=
		backpack:FindFirstChild("Portal Gun")

	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local character=
		player.Character

	if character then

		local equipped=
			character:FindFirstChild("Portal Gun")

		if equipped then
			equipped:Destroy()
		end
	end

	createPortalGun()
end

setup()

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	removePortal("Portal1")
	removePortal("Portal2")

	gunEquipped=false
	portalCooldown=false

	task.wait(1)

	setup()
end)
features: Can teleport ricks portal or smth mobile
